capabilities: Search notes by meaning with merged keyword, semantic, and fuzzy-title ranking
Suggest wikilinks between semantically related but unlinked notes via dismissible pairs
Draw relation graphs, semantic paths, and in-place graph expansions as Canvas files
Surface long-untouched Cold notes related to your recent focus and export MOCs
Generate note descriptions, tags, and topic-grouped MOCs with an optional LLM
disambiguation: Despite the name, it does not reorganize your notes; every suggested connection waits for your yes or no before anything is written.
extras: README includes audit disclosures (vault enumeration, bundled transformers library), privacy notes on API-key storage, a BRAT install path, and a mobile availability table; mobile devices act as read-only consumers of the desktop-built index.
motivation: The author kept unable to find notes without their original keywords, found manually linking scattered related notes tedious, and watched years of notes turn into 'lost memories'; they also did not want AI to reorganize the vault into 'the AI's memory, not mine'.
problem: Obsidian's keyword search fails when you phrase things differently, and related notes stay unlinked and forgotten unless you connect and revisit them by hand.

relations.evidence: For other languages, switch to Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible service.

requires.name: OpenAI-compatible API key for remote endpoints

summary: Local-first semantic search plugin that finds notes by meaning, suggests wikilinks between unlinked notes on Canvas, and resurfaces forgotten notes.
